name: agent-recall-monorepo
description: AgentRecall stable and preview desktop applications.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:v1 && npm run setup:v2
scripts.test: npm run test:repo && npm run test:v1 && npm run test:v2
scripts.test:scripts: npm run test:repo && npm --prefix apps/main-1.0 run test:scripts && npm --prefix apps/main-2.0 run test:scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/main-1.0 run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/main-2.0 run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/main-1.0 run build && npm --prefix apps/main-2.0 run build
scripts.release:preflight: npm run release-note:check && npm run package:smoke:all && npm run release:preflight:openviking
